description: The Municipality of Genova's energy-policy service publishes annual private-transport fuel consumption and associated carbon dioxide emissions for 2011 to 2015. Five CSV resources group cars and motorcycles by year and fuel type. The metadata defines consumption in MWh per year and emissions in tonnes per year, and supplies calorific conversion factors. It explicitly states that electric-vehicle consumption values are unavailable. These calculated transport-energy accounts can provide historical inputs and comparison totals for transport-emission scenarios. They are city aggregates, not vehicle trajectories, trip records or measurements on individual road segments. Access is public and free under CC BY 4.0. A caveat is that users must retain the source's fuel definitions and missing electric-vehicle coverage when combining years. The related, separately catalogued Genova public-transport consumption dataset covers buses, metro and special vehicles; its system boundary differs from this private-transport account.
